intent.text: No on the question as put. I would vote yes for the motion the maker accepted in r4: one cross-family verifier, the plan itself handed over with its reasoning, any separate self-assessment withheld, each failed claim returned as replacement text, and a council only for decisions the findings raise. Condition 1 as put still withholds the author's reasoning. That leaves a grade the author patches alone, which is the review that does not improve the draft. The acceptance in debate did not change the words now before us, so I cannot vote yes on them.
